text: dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog 是 DSH 网页端的 Obsidian 知识库目录插件，可在对话视图浏览选定 vault 中的 Markdown 笔记。主机端扫描文件并提供数据接口，客户端按文件夹展示笔记。用户可搜索标题、路径、标签和小标题，查看字数、修改时间与标题大纲，展开折叠目录，并复制笔记或文件夹的 @ 路径用于对话引用；也可从面板切换 vault。默认读取主目录下的 obsidian 文件夹，DSH_OBSIDIAN_VAULT 可指定初始路径，所选路径保存在本机配置文件中；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog displays Obsidian notes in a DSH web view. It groups Markdown by folder, searches titles, paths, tags, and headings, shows outlines and counts, copies @ paths into chat, and switches vaults. Paths are stored locally; no key or external service is needed.
想在 DSH 对话里查看 Obsidian 笔记按文件夹整理的目录和标题大纲。
能不能搜索 vault 里的标签、文件路径和 Markdown 小标题，快速定位笔记？
I want to copy a note's @ path into chat without typing its full file path.
dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog 的功能「笔记目录与检索」：在 DSH 对话视图按文件夹展示 vault 中的 Markdown 笔记，以及标签、字数、修改时间和标题大纲；可搜索标题、路径、标签或小标题。
dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog README · Obsidian Catalog · 知识库目录：A DeepSeek Harness bundle that renders an Obsidian vault as a live table of contents inside a conversation view.

dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog README · Obsidian Catalog · 知识库目录：The panel reads the vault directory straight off disk on the host side and shows it grouped by folder: note titles, word counts, relative dates, tags, and a collapsible outline of each note's headings. Every note row and folder row has a one-click `@absolute\path` copy button, so the note can be referenced in the chat box without typing the path by hand. The vault itself is chosen from inside the panel, so a second vault does not need a second install.

dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog README · What it does：- **Live folder tree** — groups follow the vault's directory structure, with a note count per group. Each group and each note collapses independently; two header buttons collapse or expand everything at once.
- **Search** — filters across title, full path, tags and heading text. Search temporarily expands every match.
- **Per-note stats** — CJK-character plus Latin-word count, relative modification date, and frontmatter tags read from the vault.
- **Heading outline** — the first three heading levels of each note, indented by level, with the leading `#` stripped. A heading identical to the note title is skipped.
- **`@` path copying** — `复制 @ 路径` on a note row copies `@D:\Notes\MyVault\folder\note.md`; `@ 引用文件夹` on a folder row copies `@D:\Notes\MyVault\folder` (the vault root copies `@D:\Notes\MyVault`). Both flash a confirmation in place.
- **Vault switching** — `选择仓库` opens a directory browser: paste a path and press `Go`, walk up with `.. 上级`, or pick a drive. Directories that look like a vault (contain a `.obsidian` folder) are marked; `使用此目录` switches the panel to that vault and remembers the choice.
- **Refresh** — rescans on

dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness if the plugin does not appear, then open a session and pick
**知识库目录 / Obsidian Catalog** from the conversation view switcher.

To install straight from a checkout instead of npm:

```text
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "<absolute path to this repository>" }
```

Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x.

dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog README · Configuration：The vault is resolved in this order:

1. `~/.dsh/obsidian-catalog.json` — written by `使用此目录`, shaped `{ "vault": "D:\\Notes\\MyVault" }`
2. the `DSH_OBSIDIAN_VAULT` environment variable
3. `<home>\obsidian` as a fallback

Deleting the config file returns the panel to the fallback.

dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog README · HTTP routes：The bundle registers three routes on the host `webServer` service. All are read-only except the vault switch, and all are scoped to markdown files inside the selected vault.

dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog README · HTTP routes：| Method and path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/obsidian-catalog` | Snapshot of the selected vault: notes, tags, headings, word counts |
| `GET /api/obsidian-catalog/dirs?path=` | Directory browsing: an empty `path` lists drives, otherwise subdirectories plus whether each one is a vault |
| `POST /api/obsidian-catalog/vault` | `{ "path": "D:\\Notes\\MyVault" }` — validates the directory, scans it, then persists the choice |

dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog README · Layout：| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host side: registers the three routes, scans the vault, caches by `mtime + size` |
| `client.js` | Client side: `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)`, registers the `obsidian-catalog` view on `conversation.view` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | `- insert: [{ id: obsidian-catalog, name: dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog }]` |
| `locale/*.json` | Chinese and English title and description |
| `screenshots.json` | Storefront screenshots, relative to this file |
dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog README · Layout：The panel uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so it follows the active light or dark theme.

dsh-plugin-obsidian-catalog README · Notes：- The panel is read-only with respect to the vault: it stats and reads files, and never writes to them.
- Word counts use the same rule as the companion Obsidian plugin: CJK characters plus Latin words (`[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9'’\-]*`).
- Scan limits: at most 12 directory levels and 5000 markdown files per scan.
- Every screenshot on this page was rendered from a synthetic six-note demo vault; no real notes, paths or account names appear in them.
